items.title: FTAI Aviation (FTAI) Shares Skyrocket, What You Need To Know
items.summary: Shares of aircraft leasing company FTAI Aviation (NASDAQ:FTAI) jumped 7.3% in the afternoon session after the company announced in a press release it closed a $2.0 billion warehouse financing facility for Strategic Capital’s second investment vehicle.

items.title: Boeing Stock Commands a Massive Premium: Is It Truly Earned?
items.summary: Boeing's growth is flying higher than its rivals, but its stock price is already in the stratosphere. Is the premium justified.

items.title: Sandisk, Micron, Coherent, Boeing, Apple, Amazon, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: Coherent is the best-performing stock in the S&P 500 on Monday. Sandisk, Micron, Marvell, and other AI stocks also rise.

items.title: Boeing Falls After Army Apache Crash, but Commerical Jet Turnaround Is Crucial
items.summary: The U.S. military has grounded its Apache helicopters after two soldiers were killed near Fort Hood, Texas. But the aircraft maker needs to deliver on its commerical business.

items.title: Tomahawk Missile Production Is Surging—and These Stocks Could Benefit
items.summary: RTX won a $22.9 billion Navy contract aimed at dramatically increasing Tomahawk missile production. L3Harris, General Dynamics, and other defense companies could benefit from the ramp-up.

items.title: RTX, Pentagon Sign $23 Billion Tomahawk Missile Contract
items.summary: The Department of Defense has been pushing contractors to ramp up production of critical munitions. RTX stock rose about 1% on Monday.

items.title: 1 Industrials Stock for Long-Term Investors and 2 We Ignore
items.summary: Whether you see them or not, industrials businesses play a crucial part in our daily activities. Still, their generally high capital requirements expose them to the ups and downs of economic cycles, and the industry’s six-month return of 2.7% has fallen short of the S&P 500’s 13.9% rise.

items.title: United Launch Alliance names new CEO amid Vulcan rocket travails
items.summary: Longtime United Launch Alliance President and CEO Tory Bruno jumped ship right before Christmas last year, moving on to work with Blue Origin. After eight months of interim leadership, ULA has named Mark Peller as his replacement.
